one_line: Cloud phone system for sales/support teams, exposed via a broad REST API for users, calls, contacts, and numbers.
auth_notes: Two modes: Basic auth with API ID + API Secret (Aircall customers, API v1) and OAuth2 for Technology Partners (v2). API keys generated in the dashboard by an admin.
self_serve_notes: Requires a paid Aircall subscription; API keys available to customers in dashboard. OAuth app registration for technology partners.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Users, Teams, Calls, Contacts, Numbers, Dialer Campaigns, Conversation Intelligence, Messaging/WhatsApp, webhooks callbacks (v1 + v2)
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhook/callback system for call events (call.created, call.updated, message.received, etc.)

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP found in docs; community servers not confirmed.

evidence.note: Full API reference fetched (285KB) covering auth, endpoints, rate limits, webhooks

agent_notes: Main friction is needing a paid Aircall account; API itself is well documented.
